name: OrbitalWiki API
description: Read-only, provenance-first REST API for satellites and orbital objects. Data from CelesTrak OMM/SATCAT, GCAT/McDowell (CC-BY 4.0), Wikidata (CC0), and SatNOGS DB (CC BY-SA 4.0). Orbital data is approximate and not for operational use. Reads work without a key at 50 requests per UTC day per network, shared with everyone on it; a free key raises that to 1,000 per day. Errors from the key-guarded endpoints carry a stable `code`: match on that and on the status line, never on the wording of `error` or `hint`, which may change at any time.
